item.description: Xiaomi's MiMo team published a technical report on MiMo-V2.6, releasing two sparse MoE models: Pro (1.02T total, 42B active) and Flash (310B, 15B active). Its scaled agentic RL pipeline samples 1,568 prompts per step with 16 rollouts each, roughly 25,000 trajectories and 2.7–3.7 billion tokens, using GRPO with asynchronous partial rollouts. RL post-training costs about $2.6M for Pro and $0.9M for Flash, with Grader compute at 12.7% and 14.2%.

item.title: [infoq] 亚马逊云科技在 Aurora DSQL 中引入外键约束
item.description: AWS has added foreign key constraint support to Aurora DSQL, including CASCADE, SET NULL and other referential actions. Its absence had been the most-cited gap keeping teams from migrating to the serverless, PostgreSQL-compatible distributed database. Integrity is enforced via snapshot validation during transactions and conflict detection at commit, without locking tables — but conflicting transactions are rejected with serialization errors, so applications need retry logic.

item.title: [infoq] GKE Pod 快照可缩短模型加载时间
item.description: Google published benchmarks for GKE Pod Snapshot, which captures a workload's CPU and GPU memory plus runtime state and restores it on demand, skipping model initialization: startup latency drops by up to 89%, loading a 70B-parameter model in 37 seconds and an 8B one in 15 seconds. It's a checkpoint/restore mechanism rather than a cache and requires pods to run in the gVisor-based GKE Sandbox. Customer Codeway cut its startup from a minute to 8 seconds.

item.description: This roundup covers OpenJDK JEP 544 (ahead-of-time code compilation, targeted at JDK 28), the ZGC-related JEPs 545 and 546, JDK 28 early-access Build 17, GraalVM 25.4, the Graal Development Kit for Micronaut 5.1.5, and TornadoVM 7.0.0. The TornadoVM release adds a TileContext class and a @Parallel annotation for writing GPU kernels in Java, which is the part most relevant to JVM developers working on heterogeneous compute.
